claims.statement: For the completed fleet02/B20 r47/r13 physical hub packet, if the literal hub-core determinant satisfies |det B|>=D_star then the full ambient law has an essentially bounded density with universal bound <1.837e11. If |det B|<D_star then dist_op(B,rank<=1)<delta/8. The indefinite branch applies the completed fleet02/B20 r47 full-pair theorem at D>=D_star and kappa>=32 D_star; the definite branch applies the source-coordinate definite-pair coarea theorem.

If additionally the literal two-column physical star U has s2(U)<delta, then dist_op(U,rank<=1)<delta and the two-hub star coefficient matrix S=[[B,U^T],[U,0]] lies within 9 delta/8 of a symmetric rank-at-most-three matrix. This is coefficient geometry only; arbitrary A[K,K], outside coupling, and every nonzero tail are retained.

On the low-determinant branch, if s2(U)>=delta then the physical two-hub star coefficient matrix has s3(S)>7 delta/8. Independently, the completed fleet02/B20 physical-R2 theorem gives the full ambient fractional estimate H_{1/4}(Q)<845.823. Neither statement alone is promoted to an L-infinity conclusion.

The r13 endpoint is reduced to: a full-law L-infinity payment through a quantitatively nonsingular hub core; or a low-determinant/high-cross branch with full-law H_{1/4} smoothing and a genuine star third singular direction; or a simultaneous rank-one hub-core / rank-one two-column collar giving a rank-at-most-three star approximation.

Upgrade the low-determinant high-cross fractional branch to L-infinity by spending the external third target resource, or pay the simultaneous rank-one/rank-one star collar by grouped/Pluecker/finite-core methods while retaining arbitrary same-bank curvature and outside coupling. Fixed-edge forcing is not valid in view of the pinned anisotropic two-hub obstruction.

scope_guards: No Gaussian, moment, iid, compact-support, or log-concavity assumption.
No independence after a non-coordinate rotation or projection.
No law-uniform pointwise quadratic oscillatory-decay estimate.
No arbitrary-joint coarea or worst-fibre density-supremum shortcut.
No deletion of a nonzero coefficient tail.
Fractional H_{1/4} smoothing is not an L-infinity bound.
Continuity is not asserted by the new determinant-gate argument.
